description: Synthetic deterministic lexical retrieval and lifecycle corpus; no semantic translation claims.

records.title: SQLite WAL consistent backup
records.content: Use an online SQLite snapshot to include committed WAL records; verify integrity before restore.

records.title: SQLite 在线备份与完整性
records.content: 运行中的数据库使用在线快照，不直接复制主文件；恢复前核对完整性和来源。

records.title: Optimistic compare and swap editing
records.content: Reject a stale snapshot digest before replacing a durable fact. Read the current revision before retrying.

records.title: 旧快照修改拒绝覆盖
records.content: 编辑知识时核对当前摘要；旧快照不能覆盖较新的修订，重新读取后再决定。

records.title: Directory inode binding identity
records.content: Copied markers cannot establish ownership. Explicitly rebind a moved directory to its stable project identity.

records.title: 项目同名目录身份隔离
records.content: 目录同名不代表相同项目；移动或复制后显式重新绑定，不能靠名字猜测历史。

records.title: Archive reversible knowledge lifecycle
records.content: Archive preserves the body and revision history while excluding the memory from default retrieval. Explicit reactivation restores eligibility.

records.title: 归档保留知识与修订历史
records.content: 归档不删除正文，默认召回排除已归档条目；核对证据后显式重新激活。

records.title: Gateway lease execution fingerprint
records.content: An execution lease binds a schema fingerprint, project root and approved argument digest; configuration changes expire old rights.

records.title: 网关默认拒绝与精确许可
records.content: 目录查询不启动后端；核对工具参数、目录和到期时间后由操作人授予精确许可。

records.title: Progress independent operations database
records.content: Task checkpoints belong to the bounded operations database. They do not become durable knowledge facts.

records.title: 工作账本不是长期知识
records.content: 普通进度写入精确项目根目录与任务线的工作账本，不把完整对话、猜测或日志当作长期事实。

records.title: WAL shipping replication policy
records.content: Replication transport is disabled in the local-only runtime. Online upload is not an installation requirement.

records.title: 用户手改 Markdown 投影
records.content: 导出遇到用户手改正文时保留现有文件并报告冲突，不静默覆盖。

records.title: Retired obsolete protocol
records.content: retired-exclusive-marker is obsolete and must be absent from active retrieval.
